title_sq: Shitet, Vile 2-katëshe, Qeha-Shytaj, prane Equos Resort
description_sq:
Shitet Vile Unike, vetem 13 minuta larg Tiranes, prane Equos Resort!
Prona disponon nje siperfaqe trualli prej 2020m² dhe siperfaqe ndertimi prej 420m², e pajisur me dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor. 
Vila eshte projektuar nga nje studio e njohur dhe cilesia e punimeve te brendshme dhe e rifiniturave eshte nga me cilesoret. 
Ndertimi i Viles eshte i organizuar ne 2 kate. Ne katin e pare ndodhet salloni ndenjes me pamje piktoreske te natyres, kuzhina e gatimit dhe ambienti i ngrenies, nje tualet si dhe nje kinema. Kati i dyte eshte i perbere nga 2 tualete, 1 lavanderi, 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 walk-in closets, 1 depo dhe 1 ballkon.
Ne kete prone do te gjeni:
• Ngrohje/ftohje multisplit te markes GREE
• Oxhak xhami te markes Hitze
• Fasada alumini me dopio xham termik
• Pllaka, hidrosanitare & rakorderi Porcelanoza
• Instalime elektrike albaeletricca
• Kuzhine SMEG
Oborri eshte i investuar ne detaje me ullinj shekullore dhe gjelberim. Ne proces eshte ndertimi i nje pishine "infinity".
Vlen te permendet harmonizimi i struktures moderne me nje pamje panoramike te lumit Erzen si dhe stili teper unik ne kompozim.
Për një vizitë në pronë na kontaktoni!
title_en: For sale, 2-storey villa, Qeha-Shytaj, near Equos Resort
description_en: Unique Villa for sale, only 13 minutes from Tirana, near Equos Resort! The property has a land area of ​​2020m² and a construction area of ​​420m², equipped with regular mortgage documentation. The villa was designed by a well-known studio and the quality of interior work and refinishing is of the highest quality. The construction of the Villa is organized in 2 floors. On the first floor there is a living room with a picturesque view of nature, a kitchen and a dining area, a toilet and a cinema. The second floor consists of 2 bathrooms, 1 laundry room, 3 bedrooms, 2 walk-in closets, 1 storage room and 1 balcony. In this property you will find: • Multisplit heating/cooling of the GREE brand • Glass fireplace of the Hitze brand • Aluminum facade with double thermal glass • Porcelanosa tiles, hydrosanitary & fittings • Albaeletricca electrical installations • SMEG kitchen The yard is invested in details with centuries-old olive trees and greenery. In the process is the construction of an "infinity" pool. It is worth mentioning the harmonization of the modern structure with a panoramic view of the Erzen river, as well as the very unique style in the composition. For a visit to the property contact us!
